card.name: Purine metabolism terms: hypoxanthine, uric acid
card.fires_on: The word ending "ine" in hypoxanthine before "-guanine phosphoribosyl", and linking words like "of" or "inhibits" right before uric acid or xanthine oxidase terms. Seen in mycophenolate and allopurinol labels.

modes.label: Hypoxanthine ending
modes.description: The closing "ine" of hypoxanthine in the HGPRT deficiency warning.

modes.label: Link before uric acid or xanthine
modes.description: A short verb ending or "of" just before uric acid or xanthine oxidase.
